summary: South Gyeongsang stands under the national framework of the Republic of Korea. No province-specific transgender incident, ordinance, court ruling or enforcement finding was identified in the sources reviewed, so the national assessment applies across the province without local modification.
tangentialFactors: The restroom-access litigation and the surgery-free legal gender recognition decisions in the sources reviewed are national in scope and do not arise in South Gyeongsang. The one sub-national restroom decision in the inventory comes from Pohang, in neighbouring North Gyeongsang Province, where the Daegu District Court's Pohang branch awarded 7 million won in 2021 against a beauty academy that barred a transgender student from using its restroom.
localsOnly: No South Gyeongsang ordinance, provincial education-office guidance or provincial human rights body addressing transgender residents was identified in the sources reviewed. Any protection or restriction a resident encounters derives from national law and national court rulings rather than from provincial instruments.
outOfScopeNotes: The sources reviewed contain no incident, ordinance, enforcement action or institutional finding specific to South Gyeongsang; whether provincial or municipal authorities have issued relevant guidance is not sourced. The 2021 Daegu District Court (Pohang branch) award concerns North Gyeongsang Province and does not evidence practice in South Gyeongsang. National-level rulings and surveys in the inventory are not province-specific and are not treated here as evidence of conditions in South Gyeongsang.
